description:
Lawful development: Proposed use
The proposed Loft Extension would not exceed the height of the highest part of the existing roof.
The proposed Loft Extension would not extend beyond the plane of any existing roof slope which forms the principal elevation of the dwellinghouse and fronts the highways.
The cubic content of the resulting roof space would not exceed the cubic content of the original roof space by more than 40 cu.m.
The proposed Loft Extension DOES NOT include the construction or provision of a verandah, balcony or raised platform.
The proposed Loft Extension DOES NOT include the installation, alteration or replacement of a chimney, flue or soil and vent pipe.
The proposed Loft Extension will has clay tiled external dorma walls, making it a similar appearance to those used in the construction of the exterior of the existing dwellinghouse.
The eaves of the original roof will be will be maintained on completion of the Loft Extension.
The edge of the proposed Loft Extension will be >0.2m from the outside edge of the eaves.
The proposed Loft Extension DOES NOT extend beyond the outside face of any external wall of the original dwellinghouse.
The proposal Loft Extension DOES NOT have windows on the side walls (Dorma Cheeks).
